event_summary: A bright circular firework-like light pattern over a dark waterfront expands, changes color and shape, reflects on the water, and fades.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a dark night sky above a waterfront with shoreline lights and their reflections. A bright circular cluster of pink and white light points is already visible high above the horizon at the start. The cluster grows into a larger round radial pattern with many short bright streaks. Its color shifts from pink and white toward red, orange, and pale gold while two narrow vertical light streaks remain on either side. Reflections of the bright sky pattern and shoreline lights appear on the water. The radial streaks lengthen and curve downward in the visible image, then gradually dim until only faint dotted arcs and shoreline lights remain.

reasons: A circular light burst is already present in the sky in the first visible frame.
The waterfront, water surface, and shoreline lights are visible from the start.
The beginning before the circular burst appeared is not shown.
